simple.summary: רָהָב (râhâb) means insolent First listed occurrence: Ps 40 5.

definitions.full: H7295. rahab [ רָהָב ] adjective proud, deflant (si vera lectio); — plural אֶלרְֿהָבִים Psa 40:5 unto the proud ; but read probably הבלים (compare ᵐ5 ματαιότητας ).
